title: Credit and Collections Reference: Missed Installment Terms of Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans)
content:
# Missed Installment Terms, Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans)

Credit and collections reference figures for missed installments on each plan of Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans): the number of missed installments within the lookback that removes the member from the plan, the length of that lookback, the wait after a removal before any account of the member may enroll again, and whether an unpaid installment bears the ordinary late charge and is subject to ordinary disconnect rules.

## Figures by plan

| Plan | Missed installments that remove the member from the plan | Lookback over which missed installments are counted | Wait after a removal before any account of the member may enroll again | Unpaid installment bears the ordinary late charge | Unpaid installment subject to ordinary disconnect rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Levelized Billing Rolling Average | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | Yes | Yes |
| Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | Yes | Yes |
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | Yes | Yes |
| Farm Budget Billing | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | Yes | Yes |
| Small Business Budget Billing | 1 | 12 months | 12 months | Yes | Yes |
| Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan | 2 | 12 months | 12 months | Yes | Yes |

## Notes for the desk

- Small Business Budget Billing is the one plan on which a single missed installment within the lookback removes the member; on the other five plans the count is 2.
- The lookback is 12 months on every plan, and the wait after a removal before any account of the member may enroll again is 12 months on every plan.
- On every plan an unpaid installment bears the ordinary late charge and is subject to the ordinary disconnect rules.

## Hypothetical counts

| Plan (hypothetical) | Missed installments counted in the lookback | Removal count of the plan | Count reached |
|---|---|---|---|
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | 1 | 2 | No |
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | 2 | 2 | Yes |
| Small Business Budget Billing | 1 | 1 | Yes |
| Farm Budget Billing | 0 | 2 | No |
